facts.fact: The document is the text of Tanzania's Access to Information Act, 2016 (Chapter 149), assented to on 23 September 2016, gazetted on 30 September 2016 and commenced on 1 July 2017 by the Access to Information (Date of Commencement) Notice, 2017; it gives every citizen a right to request information from public bodies and applies to Mainland Tanzania only.

systems.owner: Parliament of the United Republic of Tanzania; Minister responsible for legal affairs
systems.tiers: public authorities and certain private bodies, Mainland Tanzania
